description: BlueRock for AI Builders — the BlueRock Builder Toolkit for Claude Code. Say the job, answer a few questions, and a ready-made agent team hands you a shareable deliverable: an account scorecard, your brand's messaging doc, competitor battlecards, a weekly signal digest, and more. Set it up once and it keeps your priorities and your session wrap-up, all on your own files. Part of BlueRock for AI Builders at learn.bluerock.io.
